subject: MedicoRe privacy impact template & evidence pull
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@medicore.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedicoRe Compliance <compliance@medicore.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Privacy impact template for MedicoRe PII ingestion

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. As discussed, attached is MedicoRe's privacy impact template (v2). We have a few tight deadlines on our side and need a consolidated response and evidence by end of next week. Top priorities for our reviewers are:

- Data flow diagrams for ingestion pipelines (esp. tokenization and pseudonymization steps)
- SaaS data retention policy and retention windows for derivative embeddings
- List of subprocessors and their regions
- Confirmation of legal basis and data minimization measures

Can you confirm who on your side will own this? If possible, please share the SOC 2 attestation and any existing DPIA narratives you have. We can accept a secure link to a folder with artifacts.

Attachment: MedicoRe_DPIA_Template_v2.docx

Best,
Lina Gomez
Head of Privacy Operations
MedicoRe
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@medicore.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Privacy impact template for MedicoRe PII ingestion

Kimberly / team — forwarding MedicoRe's DPIA template. They want a consolidated response + artifacts by next Friday. Lina specifically asked for the SOC 2 report, dataflow diagram, subprocessors, retention windows, and answers on legal basis/data minimization.

Can one of you take the lead on the responses? I can co-ordinate and set up the secure share. Quick proposal:
- Kimberly: lead & compile final answers/cover letter
- Karthik: technical controls / dataflow diagram + infra notes
- Mina: privacy narrative + retention policy text

If anyone can't own, call it out and I'll reassign. I'll draft the external cover note once we have artifacts.

Thanks,
Alex
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 12:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Privacy impact template for MedicoRe PII ingestion

Thanks Alex — we'll own this. High-level plan and owners below. Please follow the checklist and drop artifacts into the secure drive link Karthik will create. I will do a final review and produce the cover letter for MedicoRe.

Action items:
- Karthik: produce updated dataflow diagram (include tokenization/pseudonymization flows), infrastructure notes on KMS/HSM and region controls. Deliver by Thu EOD.
- Mina: draft DPIA narrative sections: processing purpose, lawful basis, data minimization, retention windows. Deliver Fri noon.
- Kimberly: collect SOC 2 AOC, subprocessor list, signed DPA; compile answers to template Qs and produce cover letter.

Evidence needed (examples):
- SOC 2 Type II attestation (recent)
- Signed DPA (or execution intent)
- Data flow diagram (PNG/PDF)
- Subprocessor register (CSV)
- Retention policy excerpt (policy name + section)

Flagging one question from the template: they ask about embedding retention specifically. Karthik, we should clarify whether embeddings are retained indefinitely by default or within a configured TTL. If current behaviour varies by tenant, note the default and per-tenant configuration.

I'll put together a short timeline for MedicoRe and send to Alex to forward.

-Kimberly
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Privacy impact template for MedicoRe PII ingestion

Uploading initial artifacts to the compliance folder now. Links below (internal). I've included short notes for each artifact so the compliance reviewer can map them into the template.

Artifacts uploaded:
- redwood-dataflow-v1.png (shows ingestion -> tokenization -> ephemeral cache -> embedding store)
- redwood-subprocessors-2026.csv (service, region, contract status)
- redwood-embeddings-retention.md (default TTL = 90 days; can be configured per tenant via account settings)
- redwood-soc2-aoc-2025.pdf (attestation; AOC contains scope and exclusions)

Notes:
- Embedding retention: default 90-day TTL for derived embeddings unless customer requests longer retention. For Dedicated/Private customers with contractual controls, retention can be set to 0 (no persistent embeddings) or a custom window; we must reference the account flag and ops playbook.
- Tokenization / pseudonymization: tokenization occurs in-memory prior to model input; we apply deterministic hashing for specific PII fields when requested by the customer; see section in redwood-privacy-policies link.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/teams/compliance/medicore-dpia-2026

I'll keep iterating on the diagram and will export a PDF for external delivery.

-Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@medicore.com>
Cc: MedicoRe Compliance <compliance@medicore.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Privacy impact template for MedicoRe PII ingestion - consolidated artifacts

Hi Lina,

Thanks — we put together the initial set of responses and artifacts you requested. Below is a short summary and a secure delivery location with the attachments. If you prefer a single PDF bundle, say the word and Kimberly will produce it.

Summary highlights:
- SOC 2: attached AOC and attestation (redwood-soc2-aoc-2025.pdf). Scope: hosted API and control plane; excludes certain partner-managed infra per the AOC.
- Data flows: updated diagram (redwood-dataflow-v1.png) and technical notes. Tokenization happens in-memory before model input; embeddings TTL default = 90 days but configurable per tenant.
- Subprocessors: current register (redwood-subprocessors-2026.csv) with regions and contract status.
- DPA: signed copy for MedicoRe included (signed-dpa-Redwood-MedicoRe.pdf).

Secure folder (read-only link): https://drive.redwood.internal/teams/compliance/medicore-dpia-2026

Attachments included in folder: redwood-soc2-aoc-2025.pdf, redwood-dataflow-v1.png, redwood-subprocessors-2026.csv, signed-dpa-Redwood-MedicoRe.pdf

Next steps:
- Kimberly will finalize narrative answers to the template and drop them into the folder by Mon EOD.
- Offer: if you want, we can schedule a 30-min technical walk-through with Karthik to go over the diagram and retention behaviour.

Would you like the cover letter and the completed template by Monday morning or is Monday EOD acceptable?

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
Attachments (referenced): redwood-soc2-aoc-2025.pdf, redwood-dataflow-v1.png, redwood-subprocessors-2026.csv, signed-dpa-Redwood-MedicoRe.pdf
